card.name: Linking words in drug interaction statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words, slashes or periods in drug-interaction sentences about antivirals, where a drug name or lab term comes next, such as 'or' after tenofovir or '/' between indinavir and ritonavir.

modes.label: Slash in drug pairs
modes.description: The slash joining a boosted protease inhibitor pair, right before ritonavir.
modes.example: (The reference regimen for indinavir was indinavir<</>>riton

modes.label: Linking word before next drug or term
modes.description: 'or', 'the' or 'of' in a pharmacokinetic sentence, just before the next drug or measure.
modes.example: did not alter the plasma concentrations of tenofovir<< or>> para-amino hippurate, substrates

modes.label: Before hormone-binding globulin
modes.description: The word 'sex' at the start of a binding-protein name.
modes.example: corticosteroid binding globulin (CBG),<< sex>> hormone-binding globulin (SHBG),

card.plain: It fires on small connecting marks and words in drug interaction text, just before the next drug name or lab term.
